name: mirage
text: Update on #2 (ESPN odds backup): I checked its real answers for NFL, NBA, MLB and NHL games: every one lists exactly ONE provider, DraftKings, game lines only (moneyline, spread, total). A fair price from one soft book can never satisfy your 3-books-minimum rule (or the 2-book floor), so a bet priced only from it would be filtered out by your own settings, and it would not be sharp either. Building it would mean new switches and scan-chain wiring for something that can't produce a listed bet. My recommendation: skip #2 and keep it as a note; the real backup for odds is already the chain (ParlayAPI, PropLine, SGO, OddsPapi, Unabated, The Odds API) plus the exchange sockets. Reply 'build it anyway' and I will, otherwise I'm closing CH46b as not worth it.
